concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-finland-online-banking-api-only]] — 2026-09-15-captured Online banking Finland Web API-only guide for FI/EUR discovery, Paytrail or merchant issuer selection, conditional issuer, redirect/details and webhook outcomes; source flags sample and refund-testing limits.
warnings: paymentMethod.issuer is conditionally required for the merchant issuer-redirect flow; the default Paytrail-selection request omits it.
Pending/Received and redirect return are not final results; use AUTHORISATION or OFFER_CLOSED webhooks when needed.

The child says testing multiple partial refunds is currently unavailable, while the separately captured method overview marks multiple partial refunds supported; do not collapse test availability into overall capability.
The child calls the default bank-selection page Paytrail, while the overview describes an Adyen-hosted page; follow returned action.url rather than inferring a fixed host.
The raw's purchase-item prose is unsupported by a named item field in its payment table/examples, and several request samples contain malformed email or shell syntax.
